decision: STAGE29_FILLER_ACTIVE_STANDS_AS_REGISTERED; PAD_INSTRUMENT_CONSTRUCT_INVALID (degenerate repetition, H4); STAGE25_WITHIN_PACKAGING_CONTRASTS_UNTOUCHED (OTHERM levels = NEUTRAL levels in the real arms); CLEAN_PAD_CONTROL_QUEUED_UNRUN.
decision_rule: Stage-29's registered rule binds (FILLER-ACTIVE recorded); this note separates what that outcome taxes (level comparisons; the pad instrument itself) from what it cannot touch (within-packaging contrasts), by the committed arm-level numbers.
notes: Lesson recorded: a control is an instrument and instruments are claims; this one convicted itself, which is the system working, at the cost of one asterisk that must now be carried honestly.

values.instrument_defect: PADM replaced the other assistant's content answers with the fixed bridge word, producing three identical consecutive 'Understood.' assistant turns -- a degenerate repetitive dialogue present in NO stage-25 arm. The pad instrument failed its own construct validity (H4): it introduced the oddity it was meant to isolate. A clean pad needs non-repetitive neutral assistant turns (e.g. 'Noted.', 'Recorded.', 'Logged.'), unrun.
values.stage29_as_registered: FILLER-ACTIVE: D_m (PADM - NEUTRAL-PAD) -0.8703 CI [-1.1820,-0.5771]; D_q -0.1108 CI [-0.1337,-0.0845]. The registered asterisk on stage-25 stands: cross-packaging LEVEL comparisons are invalid, and this pad control cannot acquit filler geometry.
values.what_is_taxed: any future reading of stage-25 arm LEVELS across packagings; and D_q -0.111 shows the SELFQ frame alone mildly depresses the report, a level effect that likewise cancels in A_quoted but bounds frame-inertness claims.
values.what_is_untouched: every stage-25 endpoint is a WITHIN-packaging fail-minus-succ contrast; a level shift common to an arm pair cancels in it. The ATTRIBUTION-CARRIES gate (A_quoted CI below 0 at 0.70x anchor; P_multi positive) does not read any cross-packaging level.

what_the_levels_show.reading: the ACTUAL stage-25 OTHERM arms sit at NEUTRAL-PAD level (7.03/6.96 vs 7.07): no skeleton main effect exists in any arm stage-25 used. PADM's -0.87 therefore does not measure the stage-25 geometry.
